entry.title: TAJAY GRANT OPENS THE ACCOUNT! Racing United Strike First vs Arnett Gardens | JPL | TVJ Sports

media:group.media:title: TAJAY GRANT OPENS THE ACCOUNT! Racing United Strike First vs Arnett Gardens | JPL | TVJ Sports
media:group.media:description:
Racing United started brightly against Arnett Gardens, putting the Jungle under pressure from the opening whistle.
Tajay Grant was at the heart of the attack, firing off early attempts and constantly threatening the Arnett Gardens defence. The pressure eventually paid off when Racing were awarded a penalty after a challenge inside the box.
Grant stepped up and made no mistake, calmly converting to score Racing United's first goal of the Jamaica Premier League season.
With the dangerous combination of Tajay Grant and Nik Ellis causing problems, Racing United looked full of confidence as they took a 1–0 lead.

media:group.media:title: Arnett Gardens & Racing United Trade Goals in Thrilling JPL Clash | TVJ Sports
media:group.media:description:
Racing United and Arnett Gardens went toe-to-toe at Stadium East in a physical and entertaining Jamaica Premier League clash.
After Racing United took the lead from a set piece, Jamone Shepard answered for Arnett Gardens with a well-taken equalizer to make it 1–1.

With chances at both ends and neither team willing to give up control, this was a true seesaw battle.

media:group.media:description:
Jamaica’s classrooms are facing an unsettling challenge, with one in every 10 high school students reporting that they have gone to school drunk, while a similar proportion say they have attended school under the influence of marijuana or other drugs.
Uki Atkinson, Acting Principal Director of the Prevention, Public Education & Treatment Branch at the NCDA, and Paulette Spencer-Smith, Executive Director at the NCDA, discussed these findings, the factors contributing to substance use among students and possible solutions to address the issue.
